purpose: Prevent development winners, seed replications and previously inspected dates being presented as untouched confirmation
prior_reservation: Existing research status reserves no earlier than 2026-10-21, with first formal read after252sessions. A newly chosen policy cannot retroactively claim earlier reserved observations as a prespecified live test.
activation_requirements: Choose and hash one complete policy, including architecture, input data definitions, seed ensemble, validation-only selection/refit rule, holding count, rank blend if any, costs and execution time
Record candidate freeze timestamp before the first confirmation signal and start at a later eligible exchange session
Review point-in-time membership, share-class/issuer identities, delistings and corporate actions for the new period
Resolve new/untrained stock-ID support and cold-start behavior before evaluating any new-period forecasts; no random append of mixer weights
Review feature availability, historical publication timestamps and revisions; a lagged JKP observation alone is not proof it was published at that time
Use a separately sealed confirmation dataset and append-only saved predictions; do not inspect performance to decide when to stop
first_formal_read: After252completedtrading sessions following activation; one year can remain underpowered. There is no mature confirmation sample now.
comparators: Matched SPY, QQQ and the frozen parent AH+PM ten-seed recipe under identical execution, costs and dates
development_screen: Report the primary ten-seed ensemble, both prespecified five-seed halves, all individual seeds, prior-year validation forecast quality, cost stresses, paired active/SR/CAGR intervals and error complementarity. No architecture is promoted solely for highest historical CAGR.
uncertainty: Time-block confidence intervals conditional on fitted forecasts do not capture all training, prior search, universe or data-vintage uncertainty. Seed dispersion is a separate diagnostic, not independent market history. Simultaneous contrasts within a new batch do not correct all prior research.
activity: No 2026 returns opened by these experiments, no model deployed, no orders and no recurring automation created
